blocks.text: In refining the Cauldron of Blood I went back to the drawing board a bit. Based on how the Cauldron functioned in 7th edition (and using the War Altar of Sigmar / Priest of Sigmar as a proxy for it in tOW), I’ve given it another kick at the can. • Removed “Dragged Along. Added “Will of the Gods” • Increased its movement to 5 • Rather than a bound spell (or automatic ability as it was in 7th and 8th) the effect is triggered on an unmodified LD test. • Reduced the Cauldron’s LD to 8 (was inexplicably 9). • Blessings affect the Cauldron and a single unit within command range. Sisters of Slaughter cannot be selected, however, Executioners and Assassins may be (these are the other definitely Khaine worshippers in the book). • Blessings cannot be combined if you have more than one Cauldron. • Cauldron still gives a 5++ to itself, however it only gives a 6++ to the unit it joins. Bloodshield of Khaine is again a Blessing that grants a 5++ to a unit. • Separated the special rules for the crew so that they don’t accidentally apply to other elements of the model.
